name: Navigate a learning path and complete a lesson
description: Verifies a learner can open a course, read a lesson, mark it complete and see progress update.
expected: The lesson is marked complete and the course progress changes to 1 of 6.

name: Search and filter the command library
description: Verifies command search and category filters return matching learning references.
steps: Enter ip in the search field
expected: Matching network commands such as ip a and ip route are displayed.

name: Use the safe terminal simulator
description: Verifies supported demo commands show simulated output and unsupported commands are safely rejected.
steps: Enter pwd and run the demo
Enter an unsupported command and run the demo
expected: pwd displays the example lab directory and the unsupported command displays a safe help message.

name: Complete the knowledge quiz and review feedback
description: Verifies the learner can answer all questions, submit, review feedback and restart the quiz on mobile.
steps: Choose an answer for each of the five questions
expected: A score and per-question explanations appear; Try again resets all answers.
